name: Larasend Self-Hosted Transactional Email
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted transactional email control plane with HTTP API, dashboard, API keys, delivery logs, webhooks and Laravel transport; no software subscription or vendor-imposed sending quota.
watch_out: Requires your own Docker hosting, PostgreSQL, Redis, durable MIME storage, and a configured Amazon SES account or Cloudflare Email Service (Workers Paid plan). Sending, infrastructure, storage and provider overages are not free; this is not a hosted email quota.
